subject: Demo reschedule — NDA & vendor onboarding required
messages:
From: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeinc.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Live demo of Redwood Inference

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the intro. We'd like to see a live demo of Redwood Inference focused on low-latency multi-tenant inference and dedicated capacity options. Can we schedule a 45-minute session next week? Our target audience will be engineering (me), procurement, and a VP of infra.

One blocker to note: our procurement team requires a signed NDA and completion of a vendor onboarding questionnaire before any live environment demo. Procurement copied on this thread (procurement@acmeinc.com) — can you confirm how quickly Redwood can get those items in place? If it looks like the paperwork will take a few days, we'd prefer to tentatively schedule the demo and move it if needed.

Thanks,
Jordan Michaels
Senior Engineer, Platform
Acme Inc.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Live demo of Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan — great to hear from you and glad Acme is evaluating Redwood.

Totally understand the procurement gating. I can get our standard mutual NDA over to you today and we can kick off the vendor onboarding questionnaire immediately. Attached: NDA_Redwood_v1.pdf (stub).

Proposed plan:
- I'll send NDA for e-sign today (copy to procurement).
- Your procurement completes the onboarding questionnaire (we can pre-fill some fields if helpful).
- Tentatively schedule the demo for Tue, Jul 20 at 09:00 PT; if paperwork completes sooner we can move earlier.

Lauren (cc) is our commercial lead on the account; looping her in for any expedited procurement/terms help.

Would Jul 20 09:00 PT work for your team as a placeholder?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: NDA_Redwood_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Live demo of Redwood Inference

Dylan — thanks for the heads up.

We'll send the standard mutual NDA via DocuSign today. Rishi, can your team help prioritize the vendor questionnaire review once Acme returns it? If procurement needs vendor references or an SOC 2 attestation, we can surface the docs immediately (SOC2 report link is in our secure portal).

Jordan — we'll do our best to keep this to a 48-72 hour turnaround once we have the signed NDA and the questionnaire. If you think your procurement team will need more time, happy to keep Jul 20 as a placeholder.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Live demo of Redwood Inference - onboarding docs

Hi Dylan / Jordan,

Apologies for the delay. Attached is Acme's vendor onboarding questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire.xlsx - stub). Please complete sections A-C and upload to our procurement portal. Also please send the NDA via DocuSign to procurement@acmeinc.com; procurement will countersign within 24hrs of receipt.

Procurement notes:
- We require an executed mutual NDA and completed vendor questionnaire before live demos that include access to PII or non-public architecture details.
- If Redwood can provide a SOC 2 Type II attestation and a primary point of contact for security questions, that will speed onboarding.

Procurement team
Acme Inc.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acmeinc.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo reschedule — NDA & vendor onboarding required

Quick update:
- NDA sent via DocuSign and countersigned by Acme; signed copy: NDA_signed_acme.pdf (stub). DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/example_doc_link
- We received confirmation that Acme procurement has the questionnaire and are working through it; Rishi will keep an eye on any security follow-ups.

Jordan — assuming questionnaire completes this week, can we lock in Tue, Jul 20 at 09:00 PT for the demo? If procurement needs more time we can push to the following week.

Thanks all — appreciate the coordination.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: NDA_signed_acme.pdf (stub)
